programme.title: Overland Riders
programme.desc: Cowboy Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) is riding in a stagecoach with young Jean (Patti McCarty), on his way to a business deal with her father. The coach is attacked by bandits, but luckily Fuzzy's buddy Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) is in the vicinity, and he comes to the rescue, fending off the outlaws. Billy helps Jean get back home, only to learn that the bandits he's just thwarted have killed her father and pinned the crime on Fuzzy. Billy then must go after the real murderers.

programme.title: Prairie Rustlers
programme.desc: In a small town, the sheriff is murdered, and Deputy Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), a diner owner by day, must take over the slain lawman's responsibilities. The leader of the cattle rustlers who killed the sheriff is named Jim (Buster Crabbe), and he bears a striking resemblance to Fuzzy's friend Billy (Buster Crabbe), much to the deputy's confusion. Billy comes to town, and, to help Fuzzy and vanquish the rustlers, he must face Jim, his cousin, who still holds a grudge against him.

programme.title: Wild Country
programme.desc: Bandit Rip Caxton (I. Stanford Jolley) escapes from prison, and U.S. Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) track him to a small town. There, Caxton kills a sheriff, and, with the help of crooked local saloon boss Clark Varney (Douglas Fowley), installs a conspirator in the dead lawman's place. Meanwhile, Eddie comes across Martha Devery (Peggy Wynn), the distressed daughter of the former sheriff, and promises her he will bring the villains to justice.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Thunder Town
programme.desc: Falsely accused of bank robbery, Jim Brandon (Bob Steele) is released from jail after his supposed criminal partner commits suicide. Back home, he finds that, aside from his stalwart friends, Betty Morgan (Ellen Hall) and Utah McGirk (Syd Saylor), most people in his small town still believe he's guilty. Drawn into a land dispute with Dunc Rankin (Edward Howard) over his own and Betty's ranches, Jim also discovers that his dead friend may have been murdered.

programme.title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!
programme.desc: Django believes there is only one path for him to follow when he returns to his hometown and discovers his father has been murdered by a ruthless gang.

programme.title: Tornado Range
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and his partner, Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), escort homesteaders into Texas to settle. Determined to resist the settlement, rancher Lance King (George Chesebro) organizes the locals, despite both the caution of his daughter, Mary (Jennifer Holt), and a government document delivered by Eddie assuring the homesteaders of their rights. As confrontation brews, criminal rancher Thayer (Terry Frost) uses the conflict as a cover to seek vengeance on King.

programme.title: Little Big Horn
programme.desc: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

programme.title: The Trail Beyond
programme.desc: Fresh out of college, American Rod Drew (John Wayne) is asked to assist in the search for missing people in Canada. Accompanied by Wabi (Noah Beery Jr.), his friend from school, Drew travels north, but quickly gets into a confrontation with a gang of French Canadian outlaws. When the bandits abduct the young Felice Newsome (Verna Hillie), it becomes apparent they're responsible for the other disappearances as well. Luckily, Drew and Wabi are there, determined to find and free the captives.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: Wrongly imprisoned for murder, John Brant (John Wayne) decides his only option is to escape from jail and clear his name by finding the true killer. After breaking out, he ends up on the run from Sheriff Parker (Bob Burns) and catches the attention of outlaw Bob Jones (Lane Chandler), who offers to let Brant into his gang. Needing all the help he can get, Brant agrees, but running with these bandits only gets him deeper into trouble -- while the real killer remains on the loose.

programme.title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!
programme.desc: Django believes there is only one path for him to follow when he returns to his hometown and discovers his father has been murdered by a ruthless gang.

programme.title: Susanna Pass
programme.desc: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps.

programme.title: Fighting Man of the Plains
programme.desc: Gunslinger and former Confederate Jim Dancer (Randolph Scott) is on a mission to find his brother's killer but mistakenly shoots the wrong man, leading him to become an outlaw. Later, Dancer takes on the identity of a deceased marshal and comes into conflict with a ruthless band of criminals but receives help from a renowned old war buddy. Dancer also finally gets a chance to face off against his sibling's real murderer, Bert Slocum (Barry Kelley), in a tense showdown.

programme.desc: Cowpoke Ted Hayden (John Wayne) infiltrates a band of outlaws in order to get close to their ringleader, Mr. Gentry (Lloyd Whitlock) -- the man who murdered his father. programme.title: The Unforgiven
programme.desc: The Zachary family live quietly on a cattle ranch in post-Civil War Texas. Soon, the Zachary brothers (Audie Murphy, Burt Lancaster) and their mother (Lillian Gish) must defend themselves from both racist whites and vengeful Kiowa.

programme.title: Rimfire
programme.desc: An undercover Army captain (James Millican) links missing gold and murder to a gambler's (Reed Hadley) ghost.

programme.title: Stars Over Texas
programme.desc: Cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) have come to the end of a tough cattle drive, but, instead of the rancher they were expecting, they're welcomed by his sister, young Terry Lawrence (Shirley Patterson). It seems that Terry's brother and one of his employees were wounded by gun-toting thugs. Eddie and Soapy realize that they'll need to get to the bottom of things, so they devise a clever plan to lure the bad guys back to the scene.

programme.title: The Lawless Frontier
programme.desc: The parents of John Tobin (John Wayne) have been murdered, and he wants justice. He sets out to find the killer, the evil gang leader Pandro Zanti (Earl Dwire), who hides from the law with disguises and almost kills old prospector Dusty (George Hayes) and his granddaughter. John rescues them and catches Zanti, only to face criminal charges from lawman Sheriff Williams (Jack Rockwell). Zanti is let go, and John must clear his name and establish who the real criminal is.

programme.title: Border Feud
programme.desc: A feud has broken out over control of a Nevada gold mine, and Sheriff Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) realizes that he needs a steady hand by his side. Good thing Fuzzy is pals with Cheyenne Davis (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), an out-of-towner who specializes in fighting crime. Beckoned by Fuzzy, Cheyenne arrives just as local beauty Carol Condon (Gloria Marlen) is taken captive by one of the warring parties. Cheyenne and Fuzzy will have to act fast in order to free her and defuse the tension.

programme.title: Texas Terror
programme.desc: Just before Bess (Lucile Browne) returns home to the ranch owned by her father, Dan Matthews, robbers attack him and his friend, Sheriff John Higgins (John Wayne) -- and Dan is killed in the gunfight. Convinced that one of his shots resulted in Dan's death, John resigns as sheriff. Former sheriff Ed Williams (George Hayes) convinces John to work for Bess to make up for his error, and he becomes her foreman. John doesn't confide his involvement in her father's death, but Bess soon hears rumors.

programme.title: Paradise Canyon

With the full cooperation of the local authorities, Wyatt poses as a sharpshooter and begins his investigation -- only to fall for Carter's beautiful daughter, Linda (Marion Burns).

programme.desc: When on-the-lam crook Richard (Lionel Stander) and his injured partner-in-crime, Albie (Jack MacGowran), seek shelter in a remote castle by the sea, they find themselves confronted by the owners -- George (Donald Pleasence), an eccentric and weak retiree, and his oversexed wife, Teresa (Françoise Dorléac). programme.title: Ghost of Dragstrip Hollow
programme.desc: Lois Cavendish (Jody Fair) hangs out at a nearby soda shop with her drag racing club. But when she learns the shop might be closed, she calls her wealthy aunt, Anastasia (Dorothy Neumann), for help. Anastasia offers the club the chance to use her mansion as their headquarters -- but with one strange condition: They have to scare away the ghost that haunts her home. When the club decides to throw an all-night monster mash party at the mansion, it becomes clear that something is amiss.

programme.title: The Shadow Returns

programme.title: The Lost Empire
programme.desc: Long-legged women warriors dress lightly on the island of evil Dr. Sin Do, also known as Li Chuk.

programme.title: Unholy Rollers
programme.desc: A roller-derby newcomer (Claudia Jennings) soon makes enemies for refusing to play by the unwritten rules.

programme.title: Operation Kid Brother
programme.desc: Sean's brother plays a hypnotic plastic surgeon (Neil Connery), pressed into service as a James Bond-type spy.

programme.title: Salt and Pepper
programme.desc: Christopher Pepper (Peter Lawford) and Charles Salt (Sammy Davis Jr.) are hip Soho nightclub owners enjoying the good life -- until a secret agent turns up dead in their club. They find her diary and, pursuing the case on their own, discover a sinister plot to overthrow the British government, masterminded by a certain Col. Woodstock (John Le Mesurier). Salt and Pepper have a tough time getting anyone to believe their story until Col. Balsom (Ernest Clark) of MI5 hires them to foil the plot.

programme.title: Topkapi
programme.desc: Beautiful thief Elizabeth Lipp (Melina Mercouri) and criminal genius Walter Harper (Maximilian Schell) put together a plan to steal an emerald-encrusted dagger from Istanbul's Topkapi Palace. As part of their crew, they hire small-time hustler Arthur Simon Simpson (Peter Ustinov) to act as their fall guy. When the Turkish secret police capture Simpson at the border, they persuade him to spy on his partners in crime, mistakenly believing that they're Communist agents plotting an assassination.

programme.title: Matchless
programme.desc: A New York journalist (Patrick O'Neal) plays global spy with an ancient ring that makes him invisible.

programme.title: The Shadow Returns

programme.title: The Boss
programme.desc: Coming home at the end of World War I, Matt Brady (John Payne), the black-sheep brother of big-city political boss Tim Brady (Roy Roberts), is a loose cannon who gets into drunken fights and impulsively marries a total stranger, the plain but kind-hearted Lorry (Gloria McGhee). Taking over his brother's political machine after Tim's sudden death, Matt becomes powerful and extremely wealthy, but his corrupt dealings with a local gangster (Robin Morse) threaten to destroy everything he has.

programme.title: Cloudburst
programme.desc: Canadian World War II veteran John Graham (Robert Preston) works in London as a code breaker. Haunted, grieving and thirsting for revenge, Graham sets out to find the two fugitive murderers. When he does, he intends to kill them, the same way they killed Carol. But will that assuage his grief?

programme.title: The One That Got Away
programme.desc: Franz von Werra (Hardy Kruger) is a Luftwaffe pilot by trade, but an escape artist by necessity. When his plane is attacked over England, he initiates his first effort to break out of the POW camp only days after arriving. Transferred to a second, more secure facility, Franz nevertheless manages to tunnel out and very nearly steals an airplane before being recaptured. This time the Allies send him to be imprisoned in Canada, but he steadfastly insists that no cell will hold him.

programme.title: Beachhead
programme.desc: During World War II, four Marines land on a Pacific island to execute the rescue of French planter Bouchard (Eduard Franz) and his daughter, Nina (Mary Murphy). With Japanese soldiers hidden throughout the dense jungle landscape, the Marines face a daunting trek to reach their target and must endure even greater danger on the return trip with the two French citizens. In the end, one of the Marines, Burke (Tony Curtis), carries the responsibility of getting everyone to safety.

programme.title: Ten Seconds to Hell
programme.desc: After the end of World War II, six German soldiers return to Berlin and form a bomb disposal unit. Defusing bombs is extremely risky business, so every week the group contributes to a fund that will go to the last man standing. Only Karl Wirtz and Eric Koertner are left, and their once solid friendship is starting to crack. Adding to the tension is their rivalry over a local woman and one last job that could change everything.

programme.title: The Purple Plain
programme.desc: At the end of World War II in Burma, Canadian Royal Air Force pilot Forrester (Gregory Peck) is a loner whose bravery can't cover a streak of reckless instability. When his actions cause an injury, he is nearly transferred, but Dr. Harris (Bernard Lee) recommends pulling him from duty, due to the emotional trauma he's suffered. Forrester then accompanies Harris to a Christian missionary outpost, where he meets Anna (Win Min Than) and begins to find interest in living again.

programme.title: Kings Go Forth
programme.desc: During World War II, in a picturesque town on the French Riviera, U.S. Army Lt. Sam Loggins (Frank Sinatra) and Cpl. Britt Harris (Tony Curtis) both fall for the same local girl, the American-born Monique Blair (Natalie Wood). But when the soldiers learn that Monique and her mother (Leora Dana) had moved to France from the United States to escape discrimination against her parents' interracial marriage, each man must examine his own bigotry and prejudices.

programme.title: Pork Chop Hill
programme.desc: Because final peace negotiations are bogged down in political maneuvering, U.S. soldiers, led by Lt. Joe Clemons (Gregory Peck), are forced to assault entrenched Chinese troops. The site of battle is Pork Chop Hill, a daunting, desolate climb that gives the communist forces a clear advantage. Clash after deadly clash wears down the morale and readiness of Clemons' men, and when they ask for back up, command is neither willing to send reinforcements nor authorize a retreat.

programme.title: The Secret Invasion
programme.desc: When the Allies need expendable soldiers for a highly dangerous mission, they offer pardons to a group of criminals in exchange for their participation. Led by the brooding Maj. Richard Mace (Stewart Granger), the motley crew, including explosives expert Terence Scanlon (Mickey Rooney) and scheming tough guy Roberto Rocca (Raf Vallone), sets out to extract a defecting Italian general held captive in a Nazi-controlled area. As they get farther into German territory, the casualties start to rise.

programme.title: A Prayer for the Dying
programme.desc: Irish Republican Army member Martin Fallon (Mickey Rourke) rigs a bomb to destroy a British army convoy, but the plan goes wrong when the trucks allow a school bus to pass. Now, Fallon wants out. He's through killing for the cause, but in order to secure safe passage to the U.S., he'll have to take one more job: eliminating rival terrorist Krasko (Stanley Beard). programme.title: The Killer Elite
programme.desc: Friends George Hansen (Robert Duvall) and Mike Locken (James Caan) are hit men who do contract jobs for a company called Com-Teg, associated with the CIA. But, when George gets a better offer from the competition, he turns on Mike, breaking his elbow and shoulder. It takes Mike a long time and a lot of physical therapy to get back on the job, but he does -- and coincidentally finds himself protecting a client whom Hansen and his gang are simultaneously being paid to assassinate.

programme.title: Never on Sunday
programme.desc: Free spirit and prostitute Ilya (Melina Mercouri) lives in a Greek port city. Open and amiable, she makes friends often and easily. She encounters Homer Thrace (Jules Dassin), a vacationing American who is obsessed with ancient Greek culture. Homer feels that modern Greece is a shadow of its former self, and he believes that Ilya is a prime example of contemporary decadence. He makes it his goal to amend Ilya's easygoing ways, but she has stronger principles than Homer expected.

programme.title: The Knack... and How to Get It
programme.desc: Desperate to improve his luck with women, London schoolteacher Colin (Michael Crawford) enlists his artist roommate, Tom (Donal Donnelly), to help drag a brass bed back to their flat. Along the way they meet Nancy (Rita Tushingham), a new girl in town, who follows them home. There they encounter Tolen (Ray Brooks), the third roommate and a consummate lady-killer. He tries to help Colin seduce Nancy, but ends up whisking her away on his motorcycle instead, and Colin is determined to get her back.

programme.title: The First Time
programme.desc: Searching for a Canadian bordello leads three teenage boys to a British beauty who scares them.

programme.title: The Happy Thieves
programme.desc: An art thief (Rex Harrison), his lover (Rita Hayworth) and a forger (Joseph Wiseman) plot to steal a Goya painting from the Prado museum in Madrid.

programme.title: Namu, the Killer Whale
programme.desc: After fishermen off the coast of Washington state slay a killer whale, the dead animal's mate founders in the coastal waters. Marine biologist Hank Donner (Robert Lansing) finds the surviving whale and forges a bond with the animal while documenting his scientific observations. Though some believe killer whales are vicious, local woman Kate Rand (Lee Meriwether) and her young daughter, Lisa (Robin Mattson), warm to Hank's new pal, even as fishermen state their plans to kill the whale.

programme.title: Moulin Rouge
programme.desc: Visually exquisite biopic of Toulouse-Lautrec, the crippled painter whose work perfectly captured the spirit of Bohemian Paris in the naughty 1890s. Portrayed as an embittered loner, he is tormented by his doomed relationships with prostitute Marie Charlet and sympathetic model Myriamme.

programme.title: Stolen Hours
programme.desc: Laura (Susan Hayward), an American heiress in London, is a party girl living it up, in denial of her serious illness. She rebuffs the concerns of her ex-lover (Edward Judd) and keeps her health a secret from her sister (Diane Baker). Eventually, John (Michael Craig), a handsome doctor, demands she get treatment, and Laura finally listens. Doctor and patient fall in love and move to a house on the Cornish coast. In her dying days, the restless heiress searches for humility, happiness and peace.

programme.title: Adventures of Kitty O'Day
programme.desc: Kitty O'Day (Jean Parker) is a switchboard operator at a busy hotel where her boyfriend, Johnny (Peter Cookson), also works. Suspicious about some strange noises, she sends Johnny to her employer's apartment, where Johnny finds the boss has been murdered. Kitty is determined to find the culprit, but the hotheaded Inspector Clancy (Tim Ryan) is also on the case, and, as more bodies pile up at the hotel, the police start to throw accusations at Kitty and her amateur crime-solving crew.

programme.title: Ladybug, Ladybug
programme.desc: The teachers and students of a countryside elementary school are thrown into a panic when an air raid siren goes off, warning them of an imminent nuclear attack. They are unaware that it has gone off by mistake, and separate the children into groups -- one of which is headed by the anxious Mrs. Andrews (Nancy Marchand) -- to take them home. Harriet (Alice Playten) invites her classmates into her family's bomb shelter, but tragedy strikes when she won't allow one of her classmates to enter.

programme.title: Wild in the Streets
programme.desc: Archetypal 1960s musician Max Frost (Christopher Jones) lends his backing to a Senate candidate who wants to give 18-year-olds the right to vote, but he takes things a step further than expected. Inspired by their hero's words, Max's fans pressure their leaders into extending the vote to citizens as young as 15. Max and his followers capitalize on their might by bringing new issues to the fore, but, drunk on power, they soon take generational warfare to terrible extremes.

programme.title: The Group
programme.desc: Eight young women from the Vassar College class of 1933 rush out into the world to find exciting lives, but discover nothing is quite as they dreamed. Rather than blazing trails in art, science and literature, the friends are each variously burdened with disappointing relationships, children, aging parents and unemployment. Kay Strong (Joanna Pettet), the center of the group, gradually loses faith in the promise of their lives and, as war approaches, becomes unhinged.

programme.title: The Sultan's Daughter
programme.desc: An American woos the daughter (Ann Corio) of an Arab (Charles Butterworth) who's defending his oil fields from Germans.

programme.title: Witness to Murder
programme.desc: From her window, Cheryl Draper (Barbara Stanwyck) sees a neighbor, Albert Richter (George Sanders), murder a young woman. When Cheryl goes to the police, they cannot find any evidence because Richter has hidden the body. Cheryl persists in her claims without evidence, leading concerned policeman Larry Mathews (Gary Merrill) to worry that she is becoming obsessed. After Richter becomes aware of Cheryl's accusations, he conspires to make it appear that she is insane.

programme.title: Top Banana
programme.desc: Tyrannical TV star Jerry Biffle (Phil Silvers) wants to boost the sagging ratings for his comedy series. What better way to do that than by casting a couple of hot young bodies -- Sally Peters (Judy Lynn) and Cliff Lane (Danny Scholl) -- as eye candy for the viewing public? The plan gets complicated when Jerry falls for Sally, who really loves Cliff. Adapted from the hit Broadway musical, "Top Banana" is notable for filming the actual stage production on the original sets.

programme.title: The Fall of the House of Usher

programme.title: Madhouse
programme.desc: The career of horror icon Paul Toombes (Vincent Price) ends in scandal when his fiancée dies under mysterious circumstances. programme.title: The Pit and the Pendulum
programme.desc: Elizabeth Barnard Medina (Barbara Steele) has died in the prime of life, and her brother, Francis (John Kerr), wants to know why. And when he comes to believe that Elizabeth's spirit wanders about Nicholas' castle, Francis investigates -- and is stunned by what he finds.

programme.title: Hollywood Shuffle
programme.desc: Aspiring actor and hot-dog stand employee Bobby Taylor (Robert Townsend) catches the ire of his grandmother (Helen Martin) for auditioning for a role in the regrettably titled exploitation film Jivetime Jimmy's Revenge. When Tinseltown Studios casts Taylor in the title role, he has a series of conflicted dreams satirizing African-American stereotypes in Hollywood, and must reconcile his career goals with his desire to remain a positive role model for his little brother (Craigus R Johnson).

programme.title: Cotton Comes to Harlem
programme.desc: Harlem's African-American population is being ripped off by the Rev. Deke O'Malley (Calvin Lockhart), who dishonestly claims that small donations will secure parcels of land in Africa. When New York City police officers Gravedigger Jones (Godfrey Cambridge) and Coffin Ed Johnson (Raymond St. Jacques) look into O'Malley's scam, they learn that the cash is being smuggled inside a bale of cotton. But the police, O'Malley and lots of others find themselves scrambling when the money goes missing.

programme.title: Slaughter
programme.desc: After his parents are killed by a car bomb, a former Green Beret named Slaughter (Jim Brown) begins investigating and is shocked to discover they were targets of a Mafia hit. He decides to settle the score on his own and successfully takes out some of the gangsters responsible before being caught by police. Now faced with a murder charge, Slaughter strikes a deal with government officials to have the charges dropped provided he can find and kill another gangster who's since fled to Mexico.

programme.title: Diary of a Hitman
programme.desc: A veteran hit man, Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is ready to call it quits and leave the profession. Dekker's final job, however, proves to be trickier than expected when the sadistic Zidzyck (Lewis Smith) recruits the assassin to kill his wife, Jain (Sherilyn Fenn), along with the couple's baby. While Dekker has a change of heart and resolves not to shoot Jain and her child, his decision places all their lives in danger, since Zidzyck has dispatched another killer to perform the task.

programme.title: Penitentiary
programme.desc: Hitchhiker Martel "Too Sweet" Gordone gets a lift from prostitute Linda in her van and travels with her to meet her clients. After a fight breaks out with the men, Gordone is knocked unconscious and awakens to find he has been wrongly charged with murder. As a way to protect himself in prison, Gordone starts fighting other inmates. This leads him to discover an underground boxing tournament, with the top prize being a prison release.

programme.title: Penitentiary II
programme.desc: Boxer "Too Sweet" Gordone (Leon Isaac Kennedy) tries keeping his nose clean after being paroled from prison. He could box, but he doesn't want to go back to that life. He works as a deliveryman instead, and starts seeing his old girlfriend, Clarisse (Eugenia Wright). But a psychotic criminal, Half Dead (Ernie Hudson), who was Gordone's enemy in prison, breaks out and kills Clarisse as payback. The murder forces Gordone back into the ring, and he is desperate to get revenge against Half Dead.

programme.title: The Defiant Ones
programme.desc: Two men (Robert Urich, Carl Weathers) of different races, who loathe each other, escape from a chain gang shackled together.

programme.title: I Escaped From Devil's Island
programme.desc: A convicted murderer leads a band of men through shark-infested waters in an attempt to escape the fortress prison.

programme.title: The Wilby Conspiracy
programme.desc: English engineer Jim Keogh (Michael Caine) and black anti-apartheid activist Shack Twala (Sidney Poitier) go on the run together in the 1970s South Africa after falling foul of the police. Aided by Shack's lawyer, Rina (Prunella Gee), the two attempt to make their way to Cape Town where Shack hopes to return a diamond stash to the African National Congress and in turn seek help from the Congress' leader, Wilby (Joe De Graft). Unbeknownst to the pair, they are being followed.

programme.title: Visit to a Chief's Son
programme.desc: When a Western anthropologist, Robert (Richard Mulligan), brings his son, Kevin (John Philip Hogdon), to Kenya to document an eclipse and a remote Masai tribe's reaction to it, both father and son are in for a serious case of culture shock. Used to Western comforts, Kevin is at first hesitant and uncomfortable among the natives, but the English-speaking son of the tribe's chief, Nemolok (Johnny Sekka), helps familiarize Kevin with his culture, opening his eyes to a new way of life.

programme.title: The Kitchen Toto
programme.desc: In the 1950s Kenya, a preacher (Nathan Dambuza Mdledle) speaks out against the Mau Mau terrorists and is killed for it, leaving his young son, Mwangi (Edwin Mahinda), to fend for himself. Mwangi goes to work in the kitchen of the local British police chief, John Graham (Bob Peck), who welcomes him -- though his wife (Phyllis Logan) and son (Ronald Pirie) treat Mwangi with contempt. Things worsen when the Mau Mau intercede in his life again, this time demanding that Mwangi ally himself with them.

programme.title: Anna Lucasta
programme.desc: Anna Lucasta has been walking the streets in San Diego since being thrown out of home, at 19, by her alcoholic father, Joe. She's estranged from her family, but when her father and brother-in-law see greedy potential in an arranged marriage to affluent Rudolph, Anna is called back home. Old wounds have hardly healed, though. Just as Anna starts to feel for Rudolph, Danny, an old friend, returns to make life difficult.

programme.title: Halls of Anger
programme.desc: The court-ordered desegregation of an inner-city Los Angeles high school brings 60 white students into the predominantly African-American student body. African-American teacher Quincy Davis (Calvin Lockhart) reaches out to all his students, enticing Lerone (DeWayne Jessie) to advance his reading skills with racy paperbacks, protecting new student Douglas (Jeff Bridges) after a race-motivated beating and trying to quell a potential student strike led by the militant J.T. (James A. Watson Jr.).

programme.title: Black Girl
programme.desc: The 17-year-old dreamer Billie Jean is the youngest in a family of loving yet discouraging women. Billie Jean's mother, Mama Rosie, cares deeply about her three biological children. However, her own personal disappointments have left her embittered, and she only offers encouragement to her adopted daughter, Netta. When Netta, a successful teacher, returns to visit the family, she may be the voice of guidance and hope Billie Jean desperately needs.

programme.title: Visit to a Chief's Son
programme.desc: When a Western anthropologist, Robert (Richard Mulligan), brings his son, Kevin (John Philip Hogdon), to Kenya to document an eclipse and a remote Masai tribe's reaction to it, both father and son are in for a serious case of culture shock. Used to Western comforts, Kevin is at first hesitant and uncomfortable among the natives, but the English-speaking son of the tribe's chief, Nemolok (Johnny Sekka), helps familiarize Kevin with his culture, opening his eyes to a new way of life.

programme.title: The Kitchen Toto
programme.desc: In the 1950s Kenya, a preacher (Nathan Dambuza Mdledle) speaks out against the Mau Mau terrorists and is killed for it, leaving his young son, Mwangi (Edwin Mahinda), to fend for himself. Mwangi goes to work in the kitchen of the local British police chief, John Graham (Bob Peck), who welcomes him -- though his wife (Phyllis Logan) and son (Ronald Pirie) treat Mwangi with contempt. Things worsen when the Mau Mau intercede in his life again, this time demanding that Mwangi ally himself with them.

programme.title: Truck Turner
programme.desc: Bounty hunter Mack "Truck" Turner (Isaac Hayes) almost always finds his target, but his latest prize -- a pimp called Gator (Paul Harris) -- is killed while Turner is chasing him. Gator's girl, Dorinda (Nichelle Nichols), vows to avenge his death and offers ownership of her successful call-girl operation to anyone who can knock off Turner. Upscale pimp Harvard Blue (Yaphet Kotto) steps in, upping the ante with professional assassins. Turner, however, isn't going down easily.

programme.title: Drum
programme.desc: A slaver (Warren Oates) buys Drum (Ken Norton), a bordello queen's (Silvia Pinal) son, in the 1860s New Orleans.

programme.title: Friday Foster
programme.desc: On assignment from her editor, photographer Friday Foster (Pam Grier) travels to an airport to capture a few shots of the richest black man in the United States (Thalmus Rasulala). But it turns out Foster isn't the only one taking shots as she witnesses -- and photographs -- an assassination attempt on her subject. With definitive evidence in her possession, she also becomes a target of the assassins. Joining a private eye (Yaphet Kotto), Foster sets out to discover the truth behind the attempt.

programme.title: The Monkey Hustle
programme.desc: Slick Chicago street hustler Big Daddy Foxx (Yaphet Kotto) lives comfortably off petty confidence scams that he pulls with the help of loyal teenage acolytes Baby D' (Kirk Calloway), Tiny (Donn Harper) and Player (Thomas Carter). His business is jeopardized, however, when he runs afoul of neighborhood racketeer Goldie (Rudy Ray Moore). Their rivalry escalates until the threat of a freeway being built through their neighborhood obliges them to cooperate in order to fight city hall.

programme.title: Belle of the Yukon
programme.desc: A con man who has tried to turn over a new leaf, Honest John Calhoun (Randolph Scott) is the owner and operator of a dance hall in the north of Canada. John has hoped to evade both the police and his past, but his history catches up with him when his ex-girlfriend, Belle De Valle (Gypsy Rose Lee), appears in his venue as a member of a dance troupe. As John and Belle reunite, fellow entertainer Lettie Candless (Dinah Shore) also becomes infatuated with the suave businessman.

programme.title: Geronimo

programme.title: Alias Jesse James

But when James' latest scheme pairs the patsy with the bandit's sweetheart, Cora Lee Collins (Rhonda Fleming), Farnsworth and Cora begin falling in love.

programme.title: Invitation to a Gunfighter
programme.desc: From worse to terrible -- Civil War veteran Matt Weaver (George Segal) arrives in New Mexico worn down from combat, only to discover his family plot has been requisitioned and sold by cutthroat property developer Sam Brewster. When Weaver attempts to reclaim his land, Brewster hires a reclusive gunman (Yul Brynner) to take him out. However, the gunman proves uncontrollable. He refuses to kill Weaver and instead tries to seduce his wife (Janice Rule), all the while wreaking havoc throughout town.

Each day, "Good Morning Football" brings viewers up-to-the-minute breaking NFL news and local NFL stories on a national platform. The show features a combination of headline-making interviews and a discussion of a wide array of issues in the areas of sports, news and entertainment. By booking celebrity guests and opinionated national and local journalists -- and taking advantage of a close collaboration with all 32 NFL franchises -- "Good Morning Football" breaks out within and well beyond its time period.

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

programme.desc: La ballerine Dominika Egorova fait face à l'incertitude lorsqu'une blessure met fin à sa carrière de danseuse. programme.title: Avant d'aller dormir
programme.desc: À la suite d'un accident 14 ans plus tôt, Christine est affectée d'un cas très rare d'amnésie : chaque matin, elle se réveille sans se souvenir de rien, ni même de son identité. Son dernier espoir réside dans son médecin, Ed Nasch, qui lui conseille de tenir un journal vidéo. Elle pourra ainsi enregistrer les informations qu'elle traque et se souvenir peu à peu de son passé, reconstituant progressivement le fil de son existence. Mais très vite, ses rares certitudes vont voler en éclat.

programme.title: Les dents de la mer
programme.desc: À quelques jours du début de la saison estivale, les habitants de la petite station balnéaire d'Amity sont mis en émoi par la découverte sur le littoral du corps atrocement mutilé d'une jeune vacancière. Pour Martin Brody, le chef de la police, il ne fait aucun doute que la jeune fille a été victime d'un requin. Il décide alors d'interdire l'accès des plages, mais se heurte à l'hostilité du maire uniquement intéressé par l'afflux des touristes.

programme.title: Gunman's Walk

programme.title: Living Interview Special
programme.desc: Lead actor Bill Nighy, writer Kazuo Ishiguro and director Oliver Hermanus talk about their Film4-backed drama Living, a new adaptation of the classic 1952 Akira Kurosawa film Ikiru.

programme.title: Written on the Wind
programme.desc: Lauren Bacall, Robert Stack, Rock Hudson and Dorothy Malone star in Douglas Sirk's drama, a commentary on 1950s life that's disguised as a lurid, glossy soap opera.

programme.title: Man in the Saddle
programme.desc: Western. Randolph Scott stars as a rancher who's the target of unwelcome harassment by his richer and more powerful neighbour. With Alexander Knox, Joan Leslie and Ellen Drew.

programme.title: The War Wagon
programme.desc: Light-hearted western. Can John Wayne, Kirk Douglas and Howard Keel steal a gold shipment from a heavily armoured stagecoach.

programme.title: My Stepmother Is An Alien
programme.desc: Comedy starring Kim Basinger as a 1,296-year-old alien who comes to Earth to save her planet but needs secret information from goofy scientist Dan Aykroyd. Scenes of a sexual nature.

programme.title: Hot Fuzz
programme.desc: Simon Pegg and Edgar Wright's action-comedy whodunnit. A crack city cop investigates a series of grisly murders after being exiled to the countryside.

programme.title: Midnight Run
programme.desc: Action comedy. Robert De Niro stars as a bounty hunter transporting a criminal from New York to Los Angeles with the FBI and the mob hot on their tail. With Charles Grodin.

programme.title: Censor
programme.desc: Prano Bailey-Bond's subtle horror with Niamh Algar. Things get personal for a film censor who harbours unresolved family trauma, working during the video nasties panic of the 1980s.

programme.title: Sign of the Pagan
programme.desc: Jack Palance plays Attila the Hun, sweeping across Europe with his hordes and conquering all before him, with Jeff Chandler as the Roman general charged with saving the Empire.

programme.title: The Violent Men
programme.desc: Cold War-influenced western starring Glenn Ford and Edward G Robinson. A smallholder stands alone against the expansionist plans and brutal tactics of a tyrannical rancher.

programme.title: The Nevadan
programme.desc: Western with Randolph Scott and Dorothy Malone. A cunning US Marshal pretends to be a doofus to get a bank robber to take him to the hidden loot.

programme.title: The Martian
programme.desc: Matt Damon stars in Ridley Scott's drama about an astronaut who accidentally gets left behind on Mars. Oops. How will he survive and how on earth can he get home.

programme.title: The World's End
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy with Simon Pegg, Nick Frost, Martin Freeman, Eddie Marsan and Paddy Considine. Can five pub crawlers save the world.

programme.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
programme.desc: Sci-fi action sequel with Linda Hamilton and Arnold Schwarzenegger. A factory worker is targeted by deadly robot assassins from the future. Thank goodness he's back.

programme.title: Alita: Battle Angel
programme.desc: Visually stunning part-animated action film based on a popular manga. A deadly cyborg who's been brought back to life by a mourning scientist sets out to discover her true identity.

programme.title: The Rare Breed
programme.desc: Western with Maureen O'Hara and James Stewart. With the help of a drifter, a widow strives to fulfil her husband's last wish to introduce rare cattle to the perilous American west.

programme.title: Ride Lonesome
programme.desc: Western. Randolph Scott plays a bounty hunter who has unfinished business with the brother of his latest target. But his quest for revenge looks like it could be undermined.

programme.title: Flamin' Hot

programme.title: Battleship

programme.title: Rescue Dawn

programme.title: Smile

programme.title: This Is BBC TWO

programme.title: The Bidding Room

programme.desc: A family hope their colourful two-wheeler will have the bids rolling in, the dealers delight in a Picasso-inspired piece, and it's a double light-bulb moment when Nigel gets involved in the bidding.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Friends Steve, Nick, Gosia and Nick take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they must cross the Bridge, stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies.

programme.title: Wilderness with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: Simon Reeve travels three thousand miles across Mongolia's deserts and mountains, searching for elusive snow leopards and meeting nomadic people who hunt with golden eagles.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A comprehensive compilation of the latest and the most important news stories, updates and developments from the UK and different parts of the world.

programme.title: Political Thinking with Nick Robinson
programme.desc: Nick Robinson has a conversation with, not an interrogation of, the people who shape our political thinking about what shaped theirs.

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: Contestants compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.

programme.title: The Answer Run
programme.desc: Three couples face a series of 50/50 questions which hurtle The Answer Run down towards them. Across three rounds, the couples build up their cash pots, but only one pair can face The Final Run and win the chance to take home their cash prize.

programme.title: The Boss
programme.desc: Susan Calman hosts the quiz show where being in control is everything. Who will emerge as the Boss and walk away with the cash? Only the strongest players will survive the game.

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: On the final leg of his Midlands tour, Michael Portillo travels to Solihull, the home of iconic British brand Land Rover. Later, he visits the childhood neighbourhood of J. R. R. Tolkien.

programme.title: The Great House Revival
programme.desc: A traditional stone farm cottage in Knocknagoshel, County Kerry, is authentically restored, preserving its heritage and charm.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: The Roadshow visits the Outer Hebrides as Michael Aspel and the team head for Stornoway on the island of Lewis. Amongst the items brought to light are some gruesome early medical instruments, a table made from wood salvaged from a shipwreck and a modern painting bought for a song and valued at £20,000.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: The show comes from Hull's City Hall, East Yorkshire. Antique experts Caroline Hawley and David Harper are on hand to find a selection of objects to take to auction. Caroline is entertained by the story behind some Laurel and Hardy autographs, and David is gripped by a collection of postcards between young lovers from the Edwardian era.

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Cheryl Baker, Rick Edwards, Toby Olubi and Lou Sanders test their general knowledge skills on this week's House of Games.

programme.title: Strictly Come Dancing: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor ends the week with more Strictly exclusives and chats with some of the remaining celebs. She's joined by an all-star panel of Strictly alumni to discuss this weekend's performances, and Motsi Mabuse drops in for a chat.

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Featuring extensive coverage of the day's top national and international news stories, along with explanations about the context and potential aftereffects.

programme.title: BBC Weather
programme.desc: The latest weather forecast.

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: Dougie visits Ardtornish Estate in Morvern to see rare Irish cattle return to Scotland after centuries. Rosie visits the Peterhead dairy farm that is finding new markets for their milk.

programme.title: Live: World Championship Artistic Gymnastics
programme.desc: Coverage of the women's individual all-around final from Rotterdam, the Netherlands.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Horticulturists offer various techniques to elevate the home gardening experience, from repositioning roses in rustic layouts to planning vibrant spring displays.

programme.title: Chronicles of the Sperrins
programme.desc: It is Cairn Sunday, and walking guide Sean and his guide dog Bennie are on the slopes of Mullaghcarn leading the annual hike to the peak. Meanwhile, Ulster Wildlife peatland officers Rory and Bryan continue restoration works by creating dams.

programme.title: Storyville
programme.desc: Debut feature documentary from filmmaker and artist Myrid Carten, which unfolds as a powerful exploration of family, addiction and unconditional love. Carten turns her camera on her mother Nuala - who has both bipolar disorder and alcoholism - and her wider family, uncovering years of grief, conflict and resilience. Blending intimate contemporary footage with childhood home videos and elements of her artistic practice, the film moves between humour and heartbreak.

programme.title: The Blackening
programme.desc: Seven friends go away for the weekend, only to find themselves trapped in a cabin with a killer who has a vendetta. They must pit their street smarts and knowledge of horror movies against the murderer to stay alive.

programme.title: Panorama
programme.desc: Why are vulnerable people, including victims of domestic violence and those facing homelessness, not getting the supported housing they've been promised?

programme.title: Being Muslim After 9/11
programme.desc: After long careers exploring British Muslim life as journalists and film-makers, Mobeen Azhar and Masood Khan revisit their archive, reconnect with old interviewees and meet a wider range of people with important stories to tell, seeking to understand how things have changed for their community in the 25 years since 9/11.

programme.title: Piripenguins

programme.desc: The Ducklings cook up some lovely vegetable dishes, but Weasy will only eat his popcorn.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings

programme.title: Pokémon Horizons: The Series

programme.title: Winx Club: The Magic Is Back

programme.title: The Next Step: Cheer
programme.desc: Levi shows Kenzie he can be professional. Layla's mum visits. Ruby checks Daisy's socials.

programme.title: Gardeners' World

programme.title: The Wonder of Animals
programme.desc: Chris Packham delves beneath a snake's skin to discover what has made them some of the most successful predators on earth. Their simple body plan hides remarkable adaptations that enable them to rival their limbed, winged and finned counterparts.

programme.title: Carmen Jones
programme.desc: The tale of the cigarette-maker Carmen and the Spanish cavalry soldier Don Jose is translated into a modern-day story of a parachute factory worker and a stalwart GI named Joe who is about to go to flying school. Conflict arises when a prize-ring champ captures the heart of Carmen after she has seduced Joe and caused him to go AWOL. Carmen remains a flamboyant flirt and ends up being strangled by the soldier.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Christina Trevanion heads to Shrewsbury in Shropshire, where experts Philip Serrell and Izzie Balmer guide the red and blue teams as they go in search of some bargains to sell at auction in Lichfield. Christina takes a ride on the Bridgnorth Cliff Railway, one of England's oldest and steepest funicular railways.

programme.title: Live: World Championship Artistic Gymnastics
programme.desc: Coverage of the first part of the apparatus finals from Rotterdam, the Netherlands, featuring the men's floor, pommel horse and rings, and the women's vault and uneven bars.

programme.desc: Paul Martin presents from Wallasey Town Hall on the banks of the River Mersey. Paul gets special permission to go behind the scenes with National Museums Liverpool to find out how they preserve the millions of often priceless objects that are in their care at the Conservation Studios in the city centre.

programme.title: The Guns of Navarone
programme.desc: A small group of commandos, led by Captain Keith Mallory, are assigned to attack and destroy the eponymous guns - installed on the side of a mountain - that are preventing allied ships from rescuing 2,000 trapped British soldiers. Unable to attack by air or sea, the crack team is sent in, but it seems there is a turncoat amongst them.

programme.title: Amy Winehouse In Her Own Words
programme.desc: A portrait of Amy Winehouse through interviews and performances, some previously unseen. These included Glastonbury, `Later...with Jools Holland' and the Jazz and Soul Britannia series, all blended with performances from across her career.

programme.title: A Life in Ten Pictures
programme.desc: Amy Winehouse's image is known around the world. She was the North London girl with a unique voice and look, who became hugely successful seemingly overnight, and whose private life the press became obsessed by.

programme.desc: Il fait si beau que Papa Tanuki propose de pique-niquer pour le déjeuner. Taki et Taya, ravies, décident de mettre la main à la pâte et de l'aider à cuisiner.

programme.title: Taki Tanuki
programme.desc: Taki a prévu de faire un super pique-nique avec ses copains, mais la pluie vient gâcher ses plans. Elle décide alors de se transformer en nuage pour chasser la pluie.

programme.title: Taki Tanuki
programme.desc: Perdue en forêt, Taki découvre le sanctuaire du yokaï Badabubu. Elle mange une pêche trouvée dans une coupelle à offrande, faisant apparaître le yokaï farceur Badabubu.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Alors qu'il attend qu'on vienne le chercher à l'école, Jack se fait passer pour un marin qui tente de retrouver son chemin vers l'Australie.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Maman et Papa partent à l'aventure avec pour sacs à dos leurs coquines de filles. Entre les visites et l'achat de nourriture dans la rue, l'aventure est une franche réussite, jusqu'à ce qu'ils perdent leurs passeports.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey promet à sa cliente Bingo "la meilleure visite de tous les temps" en jouant à l'observation des baleines, mais il faut que Papa et Maman participent.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Lorsque les enfants veulent jouer aux crabes chatouilleurs, papa doit endurer d'atroces souffrances, avant d'être finalement secouru par une mouette amicale.

D'autant plus que le vent se lève et menace de tout faire s'écrouler. Il faut sauver la base ! Ni une ni deux, les deux copains s'imaginent que c'est une mission pour la bande de Superlapin.

programme.title: La roue de la fortune
programme.desc: Des candidats vont tenter leur chance pour dénicher les mots et expressions cachés, tout en espérant décrocher les plus gros gains offerts par la roue de la fortune. Mais attention, ils devront éviter la redoutable banqueroute et les autres pièges qu’elle réserve. Chaque jour, trois candidats s'affrontent à travers cinq manches, durant lesquelles ils doivent résoudre une énigme en découvrant un mot ou des expressions. Trouver une consonne leur rapporte de l'argent, tandis que les voyelles sont payantes. À la fin de la cinquième manche, celui ayant amassé le plus d'argent accède à la finale, ce qui lui offre le droit de revenir le lendemain. Lors de la finale, il peut remporter jusqu'à 20 000 euros ou un voyage, à condition de résoudre une ultime énigme en seulement 10 secondes !

programme.title: La meilleure cuisine régionale, c'est chez moi !
programme.desc: De la Bretagne au Grand Est, des Hauts-de-France à la Provence, des dizaines de restaurateurs bien décidés à faire briller leur région vont accueillir chez eux les chefs Norbert Tarayre et Yoann Conte ! Leur but : partager et faire découvrir la plus typique, la plus gourmande, la plus authentique des spécialités locales afin de remporter le titre de meilleur restaurant de leur région. Une compétition faites de secrets culinaires, d’astuces incroyables, de folklore et d’émotion auprès de ceux qui font vivre l’identité gastronomique de nos régions !

programme.title: La France a un incroyable talent
programme.desc:
Pour la première fois de son histoire, La France a un incroyable talent s’associe à TikTok pour une soirée d’auditions exceptionnelle.
Le temps d’une émission, les créateurs de contenu quittent leur feed pour monter sur la scène. Repérés sur TikTok pour leur créativité, leur univers et leur capacité à rassembler des communautés, ils viennent relever un tout nouveau défi : convaincre le jury en quelques minutes, loin des écrans de smartphone.
Mais une communauté de millions d’abonnés ne garantit pas une place dans la compétition. Comme tous les autres candidats, ils devront obtenir au moins trois « oui » pour poursuivre l’aventure et prouver qu’ils peuvent transformer leur succès numérique en véritable performance de scène.
Chant, danse, humour, performances visuelles ou disciplines totalement inédites… TikTok débarque sur la scène de La France a un incroyable talent avec une nouvelle génération de talents !

programme.title: Wanted : attrape-moi si tu peux !
programme.desc: Dans un lieu tenu secret, 16 célébrités seront « enfermées » dans une « prison », sous la surveillance de trois autres célébrités (Michou, Issa Doumbia, Adil Rami) qui seront leurs gardiens, avec un sens de la provocation et de l’humour qui promet déjà quelques grands moments ! Mais lorsque les portes des cellules s’ouvriront, ce sera le départ du plus grand jeu de poursuite jamais organisé en France !\r\nPendant quatre jours, les 16 célébrités, devenues les « fugitifs » devront tout faire pour ne pas se faire attraper par les trois célébrités « gardiens ». Privés d’argent, de téléphone et de tous leurs repères, les « fugitifs » devront se déplacer, se nourrir, se cacher et « survivre ». Dans une ambiance aussi fun que survoltée, « les gardiens » pourront compter sur un véhicule équipé de tous les outils technologiques mais aussi, et surtout… de vous ! Car pour la première fois en France, les téléspectateurs deviennent acteurs du jeu, en choisissant, via un numéro dédié, d’aider les gardiens… ou de protéger les fugitifs.

programme.title: Patron incognito
programme.sub-title: Georges Elkouby, président Europe de Isotoner (1/2)
programme.desc: C’est une marque qui nous chausse, nous gante et nous protège de la pluie depuis plus d’une centaine d’années qui tente l’expérience Patron Incognito : lsotoner. \r\nIsotoner est aujourd’hui la 4e marque en France en volume de chaussures vendues, derrière Nike, Adidas et Puma. Son dirigeant, Georges Elkouby, a intégré Isotoner dans le milieu des années 90, alors que l’entreprise opère un tournant stratégique dans son circuit de distribution. Rien ne prédestinait Georges à diriger un jour une entreprise de cette ampleur. C’est dans un quartier populaire de la capitale que le patron a grandi, dans une famille modeste et entouré de ses 6 frères et sœurs. \r\nAujourd’hui l’entreprise souhaite rajeunir et moderniser son image. Un gros challenge qui pousse Georges Elkouby à retourner sur le terrain en mode incognito pour observer son entreprise sous un angle radicalement différent.

programme.title: La roue de la fortune
programme.desc: Des candidats vont tenter leur chance pour dénicher les mots et expressions cachés, tout en espérant décrocher les plus gros gains offerts par la roue de la fortune. Mais attention, ils devront éviter la redoutable banqueroute et les autres pièges qu’elle réserve. Chaque jour, trois candidats s'affrontent à travers cinq manches, durant lesquelles ils doivent résoudre une énigme en découvrant un mot ou des expressions. Trouver une consonne leur rapporte de l'argent, tandis que les voyelles sont payantes. À la fin de la cinquième manche, celui ayant amassé le plus d'argent accède à la finale, ce qui lui offre le droit de revenir le lendemain. Lors de la finale, il peut remporter jusqu'à 20 000 euros ou un voyage, à condition de résoudre une ultime énigme en seulement 10 secondes !

programme.title: La meilleure cuisine régionale, c'est chez moi !
programme.desc: De la Bretagne au Grand Est, des Hauts-de-France à la Provence, des dizaines de restaurateurs bien décidés à faire briller leur région vont accueillir chez eux les chefs Norbert Tarayre et Yoann Conte ! Leur but : partager et faire découvrir la plus typique, la plus gourmande, la plus authentique des spécialités locales afin de remporter le titre de meilleur restaurant de leur région. Une compétition faites de secrets culinaires, d’astuces incroyables, de folklore et d’émotion auprès de ceux qui font vivre l’identité gastronomique de nos régions !

programme.title: MMA : Countdown UFC
programme.desc: L'UFC 333 se déroulera le samedi 24 octobre 2026 à l'Etihad Arena d'Abu Dhabi. Lors de cette soirée, le roi des poids plumes, l'Australien Alexander Volkanovski (28-4), défendra son trône face au Russe invaincu Movsar Evloev. En Co-Main Event, le poids coq russe Petr Yan affrontera le Géorgien Merab Dvalishvili. Dvalishvili avait remporté leur premier duel en 2023, mais Petr Yan avait pris sa revanche en décembre 2025, lors de l'UFC 323 pour redevenir champion. Ce troisième affrontement scellera définitivement le sort de leur rivalité.

programme.title: MMA : KSW
programme.desc: Le gala KSW 122 se déroule à la Hala Podpromie de Rzeszow, en Pologne. En poids légers, le Polonais Marian Ziolkowski affronte le Français Wilson Varela. Ce dernier, champion des -70 kg d'Hexagone MMA, fait son retour très attendu au KSW pour confirmer sa suprématie face à l'ancien champion polonais de la catégorie. Les deux combattants se sont déjà affrontés en avril 2024 lors d'un combat marquant où Wilson Varela s'était imposé par TKO au deuxième round, après une blessure à l'épaule de Ziolkowski.

programme.desc: Sonia a commandé un robot assistant pour aider Pat et Jonas, débordés dans leurs journées de travail. Pat a le sentiment d'être mise à la retraite.

programme.title: Le refuge d'Audrey
programme.desc: Alex amadoue Babou en lui donnant des cacahuètes, puis des cailloux lorsqu'il se retrouve à court de cacahuètes. Vexé, le nasique lui vole son sac.

programme.title: Moi à ton âge
programme.sub-title: Je ne dénonçais pas les autres !
programme.desc: Paul utilise sans autorisation un robot prototype conçu par Primrose… mais celui-ci saccage toute la maison. Quand Primrose découvre les dégâts, Paul accuse leur chien Bisou. Envoyé dans les années 80, Paul accompagne Primrose qui présente sa nouvelle invention à un concours. Mais la démonstration vire à la catastrophe...

programme.title: Moi à ton âge
programme.desc: Après une chute ridicule au skate-park, Paul préfère s'éclipser plutôt que d'écouter les conseils de Yanissa. Envoyé dans les années 50, Paul aide Maurice à s'affirmer face à ceux qui le considèrent comme une poule mouillée. Pour cela, il le pousse à participer à une course de caisses à savon.

programme.title: Moi à ton âge
programme.sub-title: Je devais attendre entre deux épisodes !
programme.desc: Trop occupé à regarder sa série préférée, Paul ignore Albert qui lui propose d'assister à l'ouverture d'une fleur dans la serre de Lucette. Envoyé dans les années 80, Paul assiste Albert qui participe à un concours photo. Mais ce dernier n'est jamais assez satisfait pour appuyer sur le déclencheur.

programme.title: Moi à ton âge
programme.desc: Paul est le seul de l'école à ne pas porter le dernier tee-shirt à la mode. Maurice propose alors de lui acheter, mais il se trompe de modèle. Envoyé dans les années 50, Paul aide Maurice à séduire Solange, mais celle-ci ne semble pas être intéressée.

programme.title: Moi à ton âge
programme.sub-title: Je ne jouais pas aux jeux vidéos !
programme.desc: Paul néglige trop tous ceux qui l'entourent, si bien que Primrose lui confisque sa console. Envoyé dans les années 80, Paul pousse Primrose à aller chez sa meilleure amie.

programme.title: Moi à ton âge
programme.desc: Paul fait tout pour éviter le looser de la classe qui souhaite faire un binôme avec lui pour le spectacle de fin d'année. Envoyé dans les années 50, Paul retrouve Mathis cherchant à tout prix à se débarrasser d'une chauve-souris sous prétexte qu'elle porte malheur.

programme.title: Les Dalton
programme.desc: C'est les vacances ! Tout le pénitencier embarque pour une croisière dans un superbe bateau à aubes, piloté par le capitaine Acabine. Et avec lui, on ne rigole pas ! A peine Joe a-t-il tenté une toute petite évasion de rien du tout que le capitaine les enrôle, lui et ses frères, comme mousses. Mais ce travail forcé n'empêche pas les quatre frères de tout tenter pour se faire la belle.

programme.title: Les Dalton
programme.desc: Ma Dalton a envoyé à ses fils une recette de nitroglycérine pour les nuls. Apparemment, c'est encore trop compliqué pour les Dalton car, au lieu de l'explosif, ils obtiennent une potion qui change tout en guimauve Bon, ce n'est pas grave, on s'adapte ! En versant la substance sur les murs, ils peuvent les manger et s'évader ! Mais ils auront fort à faire avec la croisade anti-sucreries de Peabody.

programme.title: Les Dalton
programme.desc: Saviez-vous que les pigeons peuvent porter jusquà 50 fois leur poids ? Cest en tout cas ce que retient Joe de latelier de Miss Betty. Ni une ni deux, Joe sarrange pour faire installer un pigeonnier dans la cour du pénitencier. A la première occasion, grâce à un appeau, les quatre frères prévoient de senfuir à tire-daile, portés par les gracieux volatiles...

programme.title: Teen Titans Go !
programme.desc: Teen Titans Go ! ayant remporté le prix de la plus longue série animée de DC, un Superman jaloux bannit les Titans dans le monde de la stop-motion.

programme.title: ICI dans votre région
programme.desc: Des magazines ou documentaires proposés par votre antenne régionale.

programme.title: La p'tite librairie
programme.desc: Une émission proposée et écrite par François Busnel Produite par Rosebud Productions avec la participation de France Télévisions François Busnel propose chaque jour de vous faire découvrir ou redécouvrir une œuvre française ou étrangère : roman, essai, grand classique ou encore bande dessinée.

programme.title: Escales en France
programme.desc: Ce magazine va nous faire découvrir les régions françaises en plongeant le téléspectateur au cœur d'une ville, d'un département français, d'une région, et lui fera découvrir son histoire, ses richesses patrimoniales, ses spécialités gastronomiques et ses lieux incontournables… Escales en France va à la rencontre de ces français agriculteurs, marins pêcheurs, artisans, restaurateurs, éleveurs, guides touristiques, tous amoureux fous de leurs régions.

programme.title: C'est succulent !
programme.desc: Leïla Albert reçoit l'Alsacienne Rosine Binder. Elle concocte une recette traditionnelle : des griesknepfle, ou galettes de semoule, ainsi qu'un gratin salé à la sauce tomate.

programme.title: C'est succulent !
programme.desc: Leila Albert est meilleure mangeuse que cuisinière. Deux bonnes raisons pour notre animatrice de recevoir dans sa cuisine une grand-mère experte en bons petits plats. Ensemble, elles vont cuisiner un plat inspiré des traditions culinaires de sa région. L'invitée en connaît tous les secrets. Un duo intergénérationnel et gourmand à la découverte d'un terroir, de ses.

programme.title: Outremer.l'info
programme.desc: Préparé et proposé par la Rédaction du Pôle Outre-mer Une production France Télévisions Présenté en alternance par Kessi Weishaupt et Laurence Theatin Le journal d'information qui vous emmène au cœur des Outre-mer et de leur actualité.

programme.title: Météo à la carte (la suite)
programme.desc: Une émission réalisée par Captain Productions Une production Enibas Productions, A Prime Group, avec la participation de France Télévisions Rédacteurs en chef : Stéphane Evanno et Laetitia Bouchon Présentée par Marine Vignes et Laurent Romejko En direct Ce nouveau format se veut encore plus interactif. Les téléspectateurs gardent une place importante dans l'émission et sur les réseaux. Les photos et vidéos envoyées vont être davantage mises en valeur.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: Terzani et son équipe découvrent deux hommes qui ont trouvé la mort lors d'une altercation entre trafiquants. Terzani s'éprend d'une des suspectes de l'affaire.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: Un matin, le corps du jeune Matteo est retrouvé gisant au sol. Sa chute aurait eu lieu depuis la terrasse de Luca Ferrero, un célèbre journaliste de télévision.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: Une quadragénaire de la haute bourgeoisie est retrouvée morte au volant de la voiture de son mari. La victime était revêtue d'une simple chemise de nuit.

programme.title: Slam
programme.desc: Un jeu réalisé par Antoine Galey, Patricia Rimond des Anges et Philippe Letourneur Produit par Effervescence Label, avec la participation de France 3 Animé par Théo Curin.

programme.desc: 19:05 19/20 METEO REGIONALE 19:07 ICI 19/20 EDITION LOCALE 19:15 ICI 19/20.

programme.title: Stade 2 la quotidienne

programme.title: Stade 2 Ligue 1
programme.desc: Page quotidienne inédite entièrement dédiée à la Ligue 1 de football, offrant une immersion totale au cœur du championnat de France : dernières actualités, résultats, informations sur les clubs et joueurs du championnat de France de football.

programme.title: Un si grand soleil
programme.desc: Tandis que Manu se sent coupable vis-à-vis d'Alex, Sérignan cherche à en savoir plus sur Alix.

programme.title: Un si grand soleil
programme.desc: Face aux zones d'ombre autour de Phynoma, Paloma décide de continuer de creuser. Quant à Alex, malgré ses précautions, il a été suivi.

programme.title: La boîte à secrets
programme.desc: Cette semaine, Faustine Bollaert accueille la comédienne et humoriste Elodie Poux, le chanteur Robert Charlebois et l'auteure-compositrice-interprète Mentissa pour une soirée festive et émouvante. Chaque invité a le plaisir de découvrir des surprises réalisées sur mesure avec la complicité de ses proches.

programme.title: La boîte à secrets
programme.desc: Pour ce numéro de "La boîte à secrets", Faustine Bollaert accueille Denise Fabre, Jérémy Frérot et Thomas Dutronc pour une soirée toujours plus festive et émouvante. Ils auront le plaisir de découvrir des surprises réalisées sur mesure avec la complicité de leurs proches. Le public doit s'attendre à découvrir des archives personnelles, des images exclusives tournées avec leur entourage. Joies, émotions, fous rires, retrouvailles et révélations seront au menu de cette soirée.

programme.title: Dialogues des Carmélites
programme.desc: Cet opéra de Francis Poulenc est peut-être l'oeuvre tragique la plus puissante du répertoire français. Pour cette production, l'Opéra de Rouen invite Tiphaine Raffier, acclamée pour l'intensité de ses mises en scène au théâtre. Accompagnée d'une distribution française, elle signe ici sa première mise en scène lyrique.

programme.title: Enquêtes criminelles
programme.sub-title: Affaire Travaglini : issue fatale pour un ménage à trois (1/2)
programme.desc:
À 28 ans, Jessy Travaglini avait un nom et un physique de star hollywoodienne. Sublime, intelligente, la jeune mère de famille, épouse d’un entraîneur de rugby respecté dans la région de Carpentras, avait tout pour réussir sa vie. Rien ne pouvait laisser penser que cette chargée des ressources humaines se retrouve un jour dans le box d’une cour d’assises. Et pourtant, la belle est accusée d’un crime terrible : l’assassinat d’une autre mère de famille, Éloïse Bagnolini, 30 ans.
La disparition d’Éloïse est signalée le 11 octobre 2013 par son mari, Alain Castel. Ce jour-là, sa compagne l’avertit par texto qu’exceptionnellement elle ne pourra pas récupérer leur enfant à l'école. Inquiet, en rentrant chez lui à Aubignan, Alain découvre leur domicile en désordre mais aucune trace d’Éloïse. Ses affaires et sa voiture aussi ont disparu. La jeune mère au foyer semble avoir fait ses valises…
Pour le mari d’Éloïse, c’est l’incompréhension : le couple semblait nager en plein bonheur, et surtout Éloïse ne serait jamais partie sans son petit garçon de 3 ans. D’ailleurs, les premières constatations des gendarmes dessinent un autre scénario, bien plus sombre celui-ci : du sang d’Éloïse macule le sol, le pommeau de douche est cassé. Ce départ précipité et volontaire serait en fait un crime maquillé… Qui pouvait en vouloir à Éloïse Bagnolini ? A-t-elle été enlevée ? Où est-elle ?
Pour les gendarmes, l’affaire va prendre des allures de crime passionnel car le veuf éploré n’a pas tout dit. Alain, cadre supérieur, entretenait une relation extraconjugale avec une collègue de travail, Jessy Travaglini. Le mari volage serait même devenu son mentor et l’aurait aidée à gravir rapidement les échelons. Coïncidence troublante, le jour de la disparition d’Éloïse, Jessy Travaglini a posé un jour de congé…
La jeune femme serait-elle une croqueuse d’hommes, ambitieuse, « qui ne supporterait pas la concurrence » comme la décrivent ses collègues de travail ? Aurait-elle éliminé sa rivale ? Interpellée, la maîtresse va faire des révélations fracassantes aux enquêteurs : oui, c’est bien elle qui a tué la compagne de son amant… Mais elle aurait agi en état de légitime défense. En fait, c’est Éloïse qui, le matin du drame, alors qu’elle venait de découvrir que son conjoint la trompait, aurait donné rendez-vous à Jessy à son domicile pour régler ses comptes. Agressée violemment dans la bagarre, Jessy Travaglini aurait accidentellement ôté la vie de la mère de famille. Puis, prise de panique, elle se serait débarrassée du corps en l’enfermant dans le coffre de sa voiture. Éloïse était-elle au courant de la liaison de son mari avec sa collègue ? Alain avait-il mis un terme à sa relation extraconjugale comme il le prétend ? La maîtresse de 53 kilos pour 1,70 m a-t-elle pu agir seule ? 
Les gendarmes ne vont pas tarder à découvrir que dans cette affaire, Jessy Travaglini et son amant jouent avec la vérité comme un chat joue avec une souris…

Dans la deuxième partie de l'émission : l'affaire Angélique Six. En 2018, la France est sous le choc : Angélique, 12 ans, a été violée et étranglée à Quesnoy-sur-Deûle, près de Lille. L’émotion est telle que le champion de football Neymar, l’idole d’Angélique, va écrire à la famille. Les policiers enchaînent les fausses pistes mais un témoignage capital va tout relancer : Kilian, 10 ans, aurait vu Angélique avec un homme dans le parc près de son domicile, le jour de sa disparition. Qui est ce mystérieux individu qui accompagnait la jeune adolescente ?

Les policiers enchaînent les fausses pistes mais un témoignage capital va tout relancer : Kilian, 10 ans, aurait vu Angélique avec un homme dans le parc près de son domicile, le jour de sa disparition. Qui est ce mystérieux individu qui accompagnait la jeune adolescente ?

programme.title: Enquêtes criminelles
programme.desc:
Depuis le 6 décembre 2016, Vanessa Melet, 37 ans, a disparu sans laisser de trace. Ce matin-là pourtant, en sortant du domicile de ses parents vers 7h30, elle avait lancé à sa mère : « Je vais faire un tour, je reviens… ». Alors, qu’est-il arrivé à cette conseillère bancaire de Langrune-sur-Mer dans le Calvados ?
Pour les parents de la jeune femme, impossible d’envisager une disparition volontaire ou un suicide. Ils sont persuadés qu’un homme est derrière tout cela. Un homme qui aurait profité de sa vulnérabilité pour lui faire du mal. En effet, plusieurs semaines avant sa disparition, Vanessa était revenue vivre chez ses parents en raison d’un sérieux problème de santé : une terrible douleur aux hanches qu’aucun médecin traditionnel ne parvient à guérir. Se déplaçant de plus en plus difficilement, la jolie célibataire délaisse les sites de rencontre pour les forums de santé et se tourne vers des médecines alternatives. Et l’un des soignants qu’elle a consultés intrigue tout particulièrement ses proches. Le médecin dans le collimateur des parents de Vanessa Melet est psychothérapeute, hypnotiseur. Fait troublant : un jour, alors que la jeune femme et sa mère sortent d’un rendez-vous médical, elles aperçoivent l’homme dans sa voiture en train de les observer. Que fait-il ici ? Son cabinet médical est à l’autre bout de la ville… Et ce n’est pas tout : pourquoi les relevés téléphoniques de Vanessa indiquent qu’ils ont échangé à quatre reprises la veille de sa disparition ? Pour Enquêtes criminelles, la mère de Vanessa Melet raconte son combat pour connaître la vérité. 

Dans la seconde partie de l’émission, Enquêtes criminelles s’intéressera à une autre disparition mystérieuse. Betting, en Moselle, le 7 mars 2020. Il est 2h30 quand Anthony Muroni est retrouvé grièvement blessé, allongé en plein milieu des voies sur l’autoroute A4. Il décédera quelques heures plus tard. Pour les parents du jeune homme, il ne s’agit pas d’un accident, encore moins d’un suicide. Et ils sont persuadés que des personnes très proches d’Anthony savent ce qui s’est passé.

programme.title: Le double expresso RTL2
programme.desc: Pour un réveil dynamique et tout en musique, Grégory et Justine vous offrent une double dose de son Pop-Rock, d'infos et de bonne humeur.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: Ve siècle, île de Bretagne. Le royaume de Kaamelott s'organise autour de son souverain, le roi Arthur. Entouré de ses fidèles chevaliers de la Table Ronde, il s'attelle à la mission que les dieux lui ont confiée : rechercher le Saint Graal !

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: En enquêtant sur le meurtre d'un biochimiste de la Navy, Abby se rend dans un laboratoire pharmaceutique. Mais des hommes armés prennent le contrôle des lieux, déclenchent le confinement et menacent d'exécuter les otages.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Le meurtre d'un officier porte la signature du « sniper des 3 États ». Mais lorsqu'un homme ayant avoué les six précédents crimes est arrêté avant ce nouveau meurtre, le NCIS comprend qu'un imitateur est à l'œuvre. En parallèle, McGee et Delilah apprennent à faire des compromis avant leur emménagement.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Le meurtre d'un Marine retraité pousse Ducky à révéler à Gibbs qu'il appartient au « consortium Sherlock Holmes », un club de détectives amateurs. La victime leur avait demandé de prouver l'innocence de son fils, condamné à perpétuité après un test ADN réalisé par Abby.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Après l'attaque d'une mission humanitaire au Soudan du Sud, un médecin de la Marine et le mari de Jeanne Benoit disparaissent. McGee, Tony et Jeanne partent sur place pour les retrouver, tandis que Gibbs reste à Washington, toujours affaibli par son opération.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Libéré du couloir de la mort pour vice de procédure, un jeune Marine demande au NCIS de l'arrêter afin de démontrer qu'il est innocent du meurtre de son ex-petite amie. De son côté, Bishop surprend son mari avec une collègue des affaires internes et redoute qu'il ait des ennuis avec la NSA.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Une gardienne de prison britannique est retrouvée morte dans un conteneur arrivé d'Angleterre. Les premiers éléments indiquent qu'elle a été prise en otage par deux évadés, dont un ancien espion du MI6 autrefois arrêté par le NCIS.

programme.title: Les apprentis aventuriers
programme.desc: Laurent dévoile la Vallée des Perles et sa perle d’or, qui offre un accès direct à la finale. Avant d’espérer l’explorer, les binômes doivent se qualifier pour l’expédition : propulser, rattraper puis lancer des sacs demande une coordination sans faille.

programme.desc: Le duo emblématique Pascal Bataille et Laurent Fontaine offre aux participants un espace rare où la parole se libère. Au programme : histoires vraies, retrouvailles, aveux, secondes chances... Et toujours ce concept inimitable : un rideau, une révélation, une décision. Confrontés à ce que leurs proches n’ont jamais osé leur dire, les invités accepteront-ils de les rejoindre de l’autre côté du rideau ou repartiront-ils chacun de leur côté ?
